description: Test suite code for Mattermost's mmctl command-line tool, including unit and end-to-end tests for enterprise features, job handling, and client interactions.

classes.name: MmctlUnitTestSuite
classes.description: Unit test suite for mmctl commands, using testify suite and gomock for mocking.

classes.name: MmctlE2ETestSuite
classes.description: End-to-end test suite for mmctl, including setup helpers for enterprise and message export testing, and client interaction helpers.

methods.name: SetupTest
methods.description: Initializes test environment, resets printer, and creates mock controller and client.

methods.name: TearDownTest
methods.description: Cleans up mock controller after test.

methods.name: SetupTestHelper
methods.description: Sets up a basic test helper.

methods.name: SetupEnterpriseTestHelper
methods.description: Sets up enterprise test helper if enabled.

methods.name: SetupMessageExportTestHelper
methods.description: Configures message export environment for testing, including license and job scheduler setup.

methods.name: RunForSystemAdminAndLocal
methods.description: Runs a test function for both system admin and local clients.

methods.name: RunForAllClients
methods.description: Runs a test function for all registered clients.

methods.name: CheckErrorID
methods.description: Checks error ID in API response.

methods.name: getMostRecentJobWithId
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent job with a specific ID.

methods.name: checkJobForStatus
methods.description: Polls until a job reaches a specified status or times out.

methods.name: runJobForTest
methods.description: Creates and waits for a job to complete successfully.
